name: ThreeDWorld Transport Challenge
summary: 基于 ThreeDWorld 物理仿真的视觉任务与运动规划基准，要求双臂智能体在住宅中寻找、抓取并运输物体，同时利用容器等工具提高效率。
summaryEn: A visually guided task-and-motion planning benchmark in ThreeDWorld where a two-armed agent finds, grasps, and transports household objects under physical constraints.
scale: Physics-driven household transport tasks with articulated two-arm agents
scaleZh: 由双臂智能体执行的物理驱动住宅运输任务
organizationsZh: 麻省理工学院、斯坦福大学及合作团队
license: Starter code terms apply; ThreeDWorld assets have separate terms
licenseZh: 适用入门代码条款；ThreeDWorld 资源另有使用条件
access: Official paper and starter code available
accessZh: 提供官方论文和入门代码
verdict: 物理驱动任务与运动规划
wmNote: 工具使用、对象状态变化和长动作链适合评估规划型世界模型；它是可生成轨迹的基准而非固定语料。
wmNoteEn: Tool use, object-state changes, and long action chains suit planning-oriented world models; this is a trajectory-generating benchmark rather than a fixed corpus.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2103.14025] The ThreeDWorld Transport Challenge: A Visually Guided Task-and-Motion Planning Benchmark for Physically Realistic Embodied AI
evidence.statement: Agents plan and execute action sequences that change object states under physical constraints in ThreeDWorld.
